mapper.select: SELECT B.PLRT_LDAT AS plrtLdat, A.ACPT_DTM::DATE AS acptDt, A.LSH_DTM::DATE AS lshDt, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.LSH_STF_NO) AS lshStfNm, B.PLRT_TP_CD AS plrtTpCd FROM ODS.S_MSEPMPMD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSEPMRID B ON A.PTHL_NO = B.PTHL_NO AND B.TMPR_SV_YN = 'N' WHERE A.PTHL_NO = #{pthlNo}

SELECT A.PTHL_PRO_TP_CD AS pthlProTpCd, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCUTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'SPM00023' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.PTHL_PRO_TP_CD) AS pthlProTpNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.WK_FMT_STF_NO) AS wkFmtStfNm FROM ODS.S_MSEPMPRD A WHERE A.PTHL_NO = #{pthlNo} AND A.PTHL_PRO_STS_CD = 'C'
